text: What does it mean when your girlfriend has a sudden change in her behavior? We have another long distance question slash story from a subscriber. So let's go straight to it. Hi, I hope you don't mind me reaching out. I really appreciate the way you give honest and thoughtful advice. And I could really use an outside perspective before our long distance relationship started. We had already met in person and spent a lot of time together when we first became long distance. We didn't talk that much at the beginning, but after a while, we became inseparable and started talking every day, sometimes even staying on call for almost 24 hours. After some time, we decided to officially be together and nothing really changed. The connection still felt strong. About a month ago, I visited her for four days, which was the maximum I could do. We won't be able to see each other again until next summer. Those days together were amazing. But after I left, things started to change. At first we talked about it and thought it was because we missed each other. We tried to reconnect, but it never really went back to how it was before. Now she barely texts me during the day and often doesn't reply at all. She usually only wants to talk at night and stay with me all night. But something feels off. She's much less affectionate than she used to be, even though she says everything is fine. Also, when I ask her what she did during the day, the answer is almost always just nothing, which makes me feel even more confused. I care about her a lot and I'm trying to understand what's going on and what the right thing to do is. I'd really appreciate your opinion. Once again, guys, if you have a dating question or relationship story, you can send it to me via direct message. I can't promise I will answer you, but if it's an interesting story or question, then there is a chance. So my answer was, hey, man, first, if you watched my other videos, you know my stance on long distance relationship. I think they normally do not work out unless you have a specific time point when you get back together. So even here, without knowing your story, I would suggest you find a girl in your city who you can be together with physically. Second, there is something weird about you being inseparable with a girl talking every day, sometimes for almost 24 hours. What is going on with your life that you have so much free time as a man, you should be busy, go find a job, do sports, study something. There is something unhealthy when a young man can't be spending so much time with a girl who he cannot see in real life. Now about a change. You should understand that one of the telltale signs of a person cheating is a change in behavior. Now, I'm not saying she's cheating on you. Not enough information, but you should keep that in mind. Technically, in this situation, it doesn't even matter. You talked about the change in behavior that you don't like it, but she kept doing it. That is enough to understand. It is the end of the story. So we go back to the beginning, break up and find a girl in your city. He did provide some more information. Here's what he wrote. Thanks for sharing your perspective. I appreciate the honesty. I actually took some of your points seriously, and I've been trying to keep myself busy lately, working more on my routine and focusing on other aspects of my life. Looking back, I think I was also overthinking the situation a bit. We did talk openly about the change I noticed because I agreed that communication is key in a long distance relationship. She explained that she's been busy lately as well. I hope she was busy with work or studies and not something else. And from her side, everything is fine. As for the timeline, we do have a plan. We see each other every summer for about three months, plus a couple of visits during the year. And the long distance phase should realistically end in about two and a half years. Thanks again for taking the time to reply. It gave me some useful things to reflect on. To that, I wrote, well, once again, I told you what I think, but it's up to you what to do with your life. One of the things I want you to take into consideration from this story is the change in behavior. If you are in a relationship and suddenly the behavior of your partner changes, suddenly she becomes more secretive. She doesn't talk to you as much. It could be the sign that she is cheating. But once again, I hope you found this story interesting and informative. My name is Ilyas Abdullin. Thanks a lot. And bye.
